# Naman Gupta

> Senior Product Manager at Digio, based in India. Seven years building fintech,
> lending, supply-chain and marketplace products end to end — from an app launch at
> national scale to using AI to automate customer support. Holder of US Patent
> 12387059 B2, granted at Capital One for identifying zones of interest in text
> transcripts using deep learning.

Currently owns the onboarding and verification stack behind 200K+ customer
onboardings a day at Digio, including the no-code builder clients use to assemble
their own KYC journeys. Previously built Ninjacart's cross-border trade-finance
business 0→1 to roughly $350M in annual disbursals, and led Invoice Discounting at
Cogoport to $20M+ of credit under management. Dual Degree (Integrated BSc. & MSc.)
in Mathematics & Computing from IIT Kharagpur.

The pages below are plain HTML and contain the full text of each case study. The
interactive versions of the same case studies render through client-side
JavaScript, so prefer these.

## Case studies

- [Case studies](https://namanbuilds.com/work/): Index of product case studies in fintech, lending, identity verification and marketplaces.
- [Ninja Credit — cross-border agri-trade lending built 0→1 (Ninjacart)](https://namanbuilds.com/work/ninja-credit/): Built Ninjacart's cross-border trade-finance business from nothing to ~$350M of annual disbursals in two months, cutting NPA from 6% to 2%. Covers the pivot from marketplace to financing, the modular credit flow, the document-chase fix that cut turnaround 75%, and the P&L I owned.
- [Selfie and liveness KYC at Digio](https://namanbuilds.com/work/selfie-liveness-kyc/): Owning the selfie and liveness verification service behind 200K+ customer onboardings a day — injection-attack defence, real-time capture guidance, face-match thresholds, and per-client risk configuration.
- [KYC funnel drop-off recovery (DigiStudio)](https://namanbuilds.com/work/funnel-drop-off-recovery/): A retargeting module inside Digio's KYC orchestration platform: step-level drop-off analytics, targeted reminder campaigns, and an impact dashboard measuring what the nudge recovered.
- [Ninja Connect — chat-based commerce and ERP (Ninjacart)](https://namanbuilds.com/ninja-connect/tradedesk.html): A communication-first commerce platform where agri buyers and sellers negotiate, order and settle in one thread. Shipped in two months; became the back engine of Ninjacart's trade.
